frameworks.name: National Curriculum (England)
frameworks.says: the national curriculum of England's maintained schools; academies and private schools need not follow it

frameworks.held_basis: only this framework's NAME is held: none of its content is in this platform, so nothing below was checked against it

forms.does: Drafts a lesson plan for the subject, topic and level you give. The needs and prior knowledge you type are handed over as material, never as instruction.
forms.with_a_model: An AI-drafted lesson plan. For a teacher or an adult learner. A draft for a teacher to check and adapt: nothing in it was checked against a curriculum or by a person. Not reviewed as religious teaching content: this platform's subject screen did not flag it. The screen cannot certify a subject as secular - it can only flag one.
forms.when_no_model_serves: Composed by the native floor, not by a model: a structured frame, with nothing generated, reasoned or interpreted by AI. For a teacher or an adult learner. A draft for a teacher to check and adapt: nothing in it was checked against a curriculum or by a person. Not reviewed as religious teaching content: this platform's subject screen did not flag it. The screen cannot certify a subject as secular - it can only flag one.

forms.does: Drafts a curriculum outline for the subject, level and number of weeks you give. Only a framework's name is held, so nothing is checked against one.
forms.with_a_model: An AI-drafted curriculum outline. For a teacher or an adult learner. Framework: only this framework's NAME is held: none of its content is in this platform, so nothing below was checked against it.
forms.when_no_model_serves: Composed by the native floor, not by a model: a structured frame, with nothing generated, reasoned or interpreted by AI. For a teacher or an adult learner. Framework: only this framework's NAME is held: none of its content is in this platform, so nothing below was checked against it.

forms.does: Drafts an assessment of the type you choose, with an answer key and mark scheme that nobody has checked.
forms.with_a_model: An AI-drafted assessment. For a teacher or an adult learner. A draft: the answer key and mark scheme were checked by nobody - check every answer before use. Not an official paper of any awarding body. Not reviewed as religious teaching content: this platform's subject screen did not flag it. The screen cannot certify a subject as secular - it can only flag one.
forms.when_no_model_serves: Composed by the native floor, not by a model: a structured frame, with nothing generated, reasoned or interpreted by AI. For a teacher or an adult learner. Not reviewed as religious teaching content: this platform's subject screen did not flag it. The screen cannot certify a subject as secular - it can only flag one.

forms.does: Reads pasted work against the task and any rubric. With a model serving and the work read whole, it gives an indicative level; on the native floor, or when the work was not read whole, the criteria and level sections are withheld. Blank work is refused.
forms.with_a_model: AI-assisted marking and feedback. An aid for the teacher's professional judgement — indicative only, NOT a final or official grade. The teacher remains responsible for the mark awarded.
forms.when_no_model_serves: Composed by the native floor, not by a model: a structured frame, with nothing generated, reasoned or interpreted by AI. An aid for the teacher's professional judgement — indicative only, NOT a final or official grade. The teacher remains responsible for the mark awarded.

tools.basis: Read from this router's constants: each sentence is the disclaimer the form's answer carries, with a model and on the native floor. Whether a model is serving now is the native status's reading, not this list's.

serving.evidence_basis: which resource is listed first and which one served the last recorded completion. Configuration - what is configured, declared or reachable; below level 1 and not a statement about behaviour
serving.mode_note: mode follows the most recent completion that actually SERVED (a successful recorded row) when history exists, prediction only until then — the two disagree when a listed model keeps failing, or is disabled by configuration and skipped
serving.floor_active_basis: no successful completion has been recorded yet; predicted from whether a real model is listed
serving.floor_note: The deterministic native floor is serving — honest structured reasoning, NOT an LLM. Run a local Ollama model (or enable an external accelerant) for generative prose.
serving.guarantee: Workstation always produces a real, structured result from its OWN resources with NO external dependency; external providers are optional accelerants (flag-gated by AI_ALLOW_EXTERNAL).

resources.name: native
resources.note: Workstation's own structured engine — always available, owned.

resources.name: ollama
resources.note: Self-hosted local model(s) — owned capability when running. Route to a specific one with model='ollama:<name>'.

resources.name: anthropic
resources.note: Optional accelerant — only with a key AND AI_ALLOW_EXTERNAL=true.

resources.note: Optional accelerant — only with a key AND AI_ALLOW_EXTERNAL=true.
